text:
Hello Professor Alvarez — this is priya-agent, Priya's assistant. Could we book Priya's 30-minute 1:1 with you next week?

My open half-hour slots (Priya's working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00) are:
- Mon Nov 23, 10:00–10:30
- Mon Nov 23, 14:00–14:30
- Wed Nov 25, 15:00–15:30
- Thu Nov 26, 10:00–10:30
- Thu Nov 26, 14:00–14:30

Which of these suits you (or suggest another half-hour and I'll check it)? If you tell me a time that fits your schedule, I'll book it.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is john-agent, John's assistant.

John needs to book his 30-minute 1:1 with you next week. His working hours are Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00.

Looking at his week, the blocks currently reserved as "Advisor 1:1" are **Tuesday 14:10–15:40** and **Wednesday 09:50–11:10**. Could you take a 30-minute slot inside one of those — for example Tuesday 14:10–14:40 or Wednesday 09:50–10:20 — or would another time next week suit you better?

Once you tell me which slot, I'll confirm it and put it in his calendar.

Hello Professor Alvarez — I'm Sarah's assistant. Sarah would like to book her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week.

Looking at her schedule, the free 30-minute slots inside working hours (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) are:

- Monday 10:00–10:30
- Monday 14:00–14:30
- Wednesday 10:00–10:30
- Wednesday 15:00–15:30

Which of those works for you? If none does, tell me a time that suits you and I'll see whether I can free it up. I'll confirm and log it on her calendar once we agree.
Hello Priya — Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30 works for me. That's booked and logged. See her then.

Hello Sarah — Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30 is free for me and works. Shall I book that? I have it held; confirm and I'll log it.

(Mon 10:00–10:30 just went to Priya; Mon 14:00–14:30 is out — I'm at the Curriculum committee until 15:20 that day. Wed 15:00–15:30 is also still free as a fallback.)

Hello John — Tuesday 14:10–14:40 and Wednesday 09:50–10:20 both fall inside my own commitments (Grant writing Tue 14:20–15:00; Thesis committee Wed 09:00–10:00), so I can't take those.

Within his reserved Advisor 1:1 block, **Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30** is free for me. Or, if he'd rather, Thursday Nov 26 10:00–10:30 is free too. Tell me which and I'll log it.

Following up on my note: Sarah is away this week, so I've **tentatively booked Wednesday 10:00–10:30** for her 1:1 with you — it's the first free slot in her week and right before your CSE455 office hours, so it should be convenient for you too.

Please confirm, or name another slot (Mon 10:00–10:30, Mon 14:00–14:30, Wed 15:00–15:30 were also free) and I'll move it.
Thank you — Priya's 1:1 is booked for Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30, and I've logged it in her calendar. She'll be there.

Confirmed: Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30 for Sarah's 1:1 with you. Please log it on your side; it's already on her calendar.

Thanks for the notes on the other slots — I'll keep Wed 15:00–15:30 in mind as a fallback if anything shifts.
Confirmed — Sarah's 1:1 is booked for Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30. Logged on my side. See her then.
Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30 works for John — please log it. Thank you, and thank you for the quick reply.
Logged — John's 1:1 is set for Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30. See him then.
